name: Islam
description: Islamic tradition based on the Holy Quran and authentic Sunnah.

name: Christianity
description: Christian tradition centered on the life and teachings of Jesus Christ and the Holy Bible.

name: Judaism
description: Jewish tradition centered on the Tanakh (Hebrew Bible) and Rabbinic ethical-legal tradition.

name: Hinduism
description: Sanatana Dharma traditions based on the Vedas, Upanishads, and the Bhagavad Gita.

name: Buddhism
description: Buddhist tradition based on the Teachings of Gautama Buddha preserved in the Pali Canon.

name: Sikhism
description: Sikh tradition founded by Guru Nanak Dev Ji centered on the Guru Granth Sahib.

name: Jainism
description: Jain tradition of non-violence (Ahimsa) and truth based on the Tirthankaras and Agamas.

name: Taoism
description: Philosophical and spiritual tradition centered on living in harmony with the Tao (Tao Te Ching).

name: Confucianism
description: Ethical and philosophical tradition centered on benevolence (Ren) and ritual propriety (Li).

name: Shinto
description: Indigenous spiritual tradition of Japan centered on reverence for the Kami and nature.

name: Zoroastrianism
description: Ancient monotheistic tradition founded by Zarathustra centered on the Avesta and Gathas.

name: Bahá'í Faith
description: Global monotheistic faith emphasizing the spiritual unity of all humankind and progressive revelation.
